source: https://www.w3.org/TR/2001/REC-xml-c14n-20010315, section 3; the document-subset example 3.7 is left out

examples.name: 3.1 PIs, Comments, and Outside of Document Element
examples.input:
<?xml version="1.0"?>

<?xml-stylesheet   href="doc.xsl"
   type="text/xsl"   ?>

<!DOCTYPE doc SYSTEM "doc.dtd">

<doc>Hello, world!<!-- Comment 1 --></doc>

<?pi-without-data     ?>

<!-- Comment 2 -->

<!-- Comment 3 -->
examples.commented:
<?xml-stylesheet href="doc.xsl"
   type="text/xsl"   ?>
<doc>Hello, world!<!-- Comment 1 --></doc>
<?pi-without-data?>
<!-- Comment 2 -->
<!-- Comment 3 -->

examples.name: 3.2 Whitespace in Document Content
examples.input:
<doc>
   <clean>   </clean>
   <dirty>   A   B   </dirty>
   <mixed>
      A
      <clean>   </clean>
      B
      <dirty>   A   B   </dirty>
      C
   </mixed>
</doc>
examples.uncommented:
<doc>
   <clean>   </clean>
   <dirty>   A   B   </dirty>
   <mixed>
      A
      <clean>   </clean>
      B
      <dirty>   A   B   </dirty>
      C
   </mixed>
</doc>

examples.name: 3.3 Start and End Tags
examples.input:
<!DOCTYPE doc [<!ATTLIST e9 attr CDATA "default">]>
<doc>
   <e1   />
   <e2   ></e2>
   <e3    name = "elem3"   id="elem3"    />
   <e4    name="elem4"   id="elem4"    ></e4>
   <e5 a:attr="out" b:attr="sorted" attr2="all" attr="I'm"
       xmlns:b="http://www.ietf.org" 
       xmlns:a="http://www.w3.org"
       xmlns="http://example.org"/>
   <e6 xmlns="" xmlns:a="http://www.w3.org">
       <e7 xmlns="http://www.ietf.org">
           <e8 xmlns="" xmlns:a="http://www.w3.org">
               <e9 xmlns="" xmlns:a="http://www.ietf.org"/>
           </e8>
       </e7>
   </e6>
</doc>
examples.uncommented:
<doc>
   <e1></e1>
   <e2></e2>
   <e3 id="elem3" name="elem3"></e3>
   <e4 id="elem4" name="elem4"></e4>
   <e5 xmlns="http://example.org" xmlns:a="http://www.w3.org" xmlns:b="http://www.ietf.org" attr="I'm" attr2="all" b:attr="sorted" a:attr="out"></e5>
   <e6 xmlns:a="http://www.w3.org">
       <e7 xmlns="http://www.ietf.org">
           <e8 xmlns="">
               <e9 xmlns:a="http://www.ietf.org" attr="default"></e9>
           </e8>
       </e7>
   </e6>
</doc>
examples.note: The recommendation shows a space after </e5> that its input does not have.

examples.name: 3.4 Character Modifications and Character References
examples.input:
<!DOCTYPE doc [
<!ATTLIST normId id ID #IMPLIED>
<!ATTLIST normNames attr NMTOKENS #IMPLIED>
]>
<doc>
   <text>First line
Second line</text>
   <value>2</value>
   <compute><![CDATA[value>"0" && value<"10" ?"valid":"error"]]></compute>
   <compute expr='value>"0" && value<"10" ?"valid":"error"'>valid</compute>
   <norm attr=' '    
	   ' '/>
   <normNames attr='   A    
	   B   '/>
   <normId id=' '    
	   ' '/>
</doc>

examples.name: 3.5 Entity References
examples.input:
<!DOCTYPE doc [
<!ATTLIST doc attrExtEnt ENTITY #IMPLIED>
<!ENTITY ent1 "Hello">
<!ENTITY ent2 SYSTEM "world.txt">
<!ENTITY entExt SYSTEM "earth.gif" NDATA gif>
<!NOTATION gif SYSTEM "viewgif.exe">
]>
<doc attrExtEnt="entExt">
   &ent1;, &ent2;!
</doc>

<!-- Let world.txt contain "world" (excluding the quotes) -->
